demurrage.unit: USD per day beyond free time
demurrage.note: Micro-step 6 berth model (Yasser GO 2026-10-11): single berth, FIFO ships; flat USD/day per ship beyond free time. Ship state machine: arrive (only while berth has capacity) -> wait (ship-day accrual, billed beyond free time) -> unload (berth->yard boundary, block rule intact) -> depart when hold empty. Demo cadence/rate values, editable later.

dispatch.unit: tonnes per tick (1 tick = 1 in-game hour)
dispatch.note: Micro-step 5 chain contract: dispatch capacity = effective_tph when crane available, 0 when crane down; arrivals at arrival_t_per_tick while yard below capacity; yard capped at yard_capacity_t; upstream restricted after congestion_ticks consecutive restricted ticks. Demo values, editable later.
